# Erah Havacılık Akademisi

> Turkey's first private aviation academy offering comprehensive pilot training from PPL to ATPL certification with modern facilities and aircraft.

Erah Aviation Academy is a leading Turkish aviation training institution based in Isparta with additional locations in Istanbul and Antalya. The academy provides integrated and modular pilot certification programs, advanced flight simulators, and a modern aircraft fleet to prepare professional pilots for international aviation standards.

## Key Topics

- ATPL (Airline Transport Pilot License)
- PPL (Private Pilot License)
- Flight Training
- Pilot Certification
- Cessna 172
- Diamond DA-42
- Flight Simulators
- Isparta
- Turkey Aviation
- SHGM (Turkish Civil Aviation Authority)
- Integrated Training Program
- Aircraft Fleet
- Flight Education
- Professional Pilots
- Aviation Academy

## Pilot Training Programs

- [Entegre ATPL](https://erah.aero/entegre-atpl): Integrated ATPL program from PPL to ATPL certification for pilot candidates
- [Çalışanlara Özel ATPL](https://erah.aero/calisanlara-ozel-atpl): Employee-specific ATPL training program with modular aviation education
- [Diğer Eğitimlerimiz](https://erah.aero/diger-egitimlerimiz): Additional pilot training programs including PPL, instrument, and multi-engine

## Training Infrastructure

- [Tesislerimiz](https://erah.aero/tesislerimiz): Academy facilities and campus locations in Isparta, Istanbul, and Antalya
- [Uçaklarımız](https://erah.aero/ucaklarimiz): Training aircraft fleet including Cessna 172 and Diamond DA-42 specifications
- [Simülatörlerimiz](https://erah.aero/simulatorlerimiz): Flight simulator equipment including ALSIM and A320 jet orientation systems
